data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: harvest-worktree refuses worktree removal when ANY guard fires.
- DD3: --force bypass prints firing guard + PR URL.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh`:

1. Source `worktree-removal-guards.sh` at the top (same pattern as T3).
2. Around line 345 where `git worktree remove "\$_harvest_worktree_path" --force` is currently called UNGUARDED, REPLACE with:
   - Call `assert_worktree_removable "\$_harvest_worktree_path" "\$_branch_name" [--force]` before removal.
   - On refusal (exit 1 without --force): emit clear error message and exit non-zero from harvest-worktree.sh.
   - On bypass (exit 0 with --force): proceed with `git worktree remove`.
3. Update existing tests (`tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree.sh`) to cover both refusal and bypass paths.

Note: harvest-worktree.sh currently uses `--force` UNCONDITIONALLY on the inner `git worktree remove` call. The S6 design changes this: the OUTER --force (passed to harvest-worktree.sh itself) controls whether the guards bypass; the INNER `git worktree remove` keeps its --force for git's own concerns (e.g., locked worktree).

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh` | modify | `tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree.sh` | needs-modification |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] harvest-worktree.sh sources the guards library
  Verify: grep -q 'worktree-removal-guards.sh' plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh
- [ ] assert_worktree_removable called before git worktree remove
  Verify: grep -B 5 'git worktree remove' plugins/dso/scripts/harvest-worktree.sh | grep -q 'assert_worktree_removable'
- [ ] Existing harvest-worktree tests still pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-harvest-worktree.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
